title: ITVX / Interface symbol family
slide_intent: Compare common interface actions for a coherent drawing character, because consistent shapes help small symbols read as one family.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen coherence and legibility in small interface elements.
demonstration: Four yellow outline symbols appear in a two-by-two arrangement on dark ground: play, search, download and heart. Rounded line endings and open interiors relate the shapes.
practical_value: Compare common interface actions for a coherent drawing character.

content_islands.name: Upper row
content_islands.spec: Play and search use simple directional and circular forms.

content_islands.name: Lower row
content_islands.spec: Download and heart continue the outline treatment.

content_islands.name: Field
content_islands.spec: Dark negative space separates the four symbols.
